nodes.name: animate.rs
nodes.summary: Derive macro implementation for the `Animate` trait, generating animation interpolation code for CSS style types.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses synstructure for enum variant iteration and darling for attribute parsing.

nodes.name: derive
nodes.summary: Generates Animate trait impl with match-body per variant, adding where-clause bounds for type parameters.

nodes.name: derive_variant_arm
nodes.summary: Generates a single match arm for an enum variant's Animate implementation, handling error, constant, and field-bound cases.

nodes.name: AnimationInputAttrs
nodes.summary: Derive input attributes parsed from #[animation(...)] for controlling Animate derive behavior.

nodes.name: AnimationVariantAttrs
nodes.summary: Variant-level attributes parsed from #[animation(...)] for error handling and bound control.

nodes.name: AnimationFieldAttrs
nodes.summary: Field-level attributes parsed from #[animation(...)] for constant and field-bound settings.

nodes.name: cg.rs
nodes.summary: Code generation utilities shared across all style derive macros, providing attribute parsing, type mapping, and pattern-binding helpers.
nodes.languageNotes: Central helper module implementing the synstructure-based derive pattern used by all style_derive submodules.

nodes.name: propagate_clauses_to_output_type
nodes.summary: Propagates where-clause bounds from input types to their associated output types in trait implementations.

nodes.name: add_predicate
nodes.summary: Adds a where-clause predicate, initializing the clause if necessary.

nodes.name: fmap2_match
nodes.summary: Core pattern-matching code generator that transforms variant bindings with two mapping closures for value conversion.

nodes.name: fmap_trait_output
nodes.summary: Constructs the output type path by mapping each generic parameter to its trait-associated type.

nodes.name: map_type_params
nodes.summary: Recursively maps type parameters within complex type expressions, handling slices, arrays, tuples, paths, and qualified self-types.

nodes.name: map_type_params_in_path
nodes.summary: Maps type parameters within path segments, handling angle-bracketed generic arguments and associated types.

nodes.name: parse_field_attrs
nodes.summary: Parses darling attributes from a syn Field node with panic-on-error.

nodes.name: parse_input_attrs
nodes.summary: Parses darling attributes from a syn DeriveInput node with panic-on-error.

nodes.name: parse_variant_attrs_from_ast
nodes.summary: Parses darling attributes from a synstructure VariantAst by converting to syn Variant first.

nodes.name: ref_pattern
nodes.summary: Creates a ref-pattern with renamed bindings for use in match arms during derive code generation.

nodes.name: value
nodes.summary: Creates a move-pattern with renamed bindings for generating result values in derive match arms.

nodes.name: to_css_identifier
nodes.summary: Converts CamelCase Rust identifiers to hyphenated CSS identifiers, handling Moz/Webkit/Servo vendor prefixes.

nodes.name: compute_squared_distance.rs
nodes.summary: Derive macro implementation for the `ComputeSquaredDistance` trait, generating distance computation for CSS animation interpolation.

nodes.summary: Generates ComputeSquaredDistance trait impl with match-body, adding bounds for type parameters.

nodes.name: derive_variant_arm
nodes.summary: Generates match arm summing squared distances for each field, with constant and field-bound handling.

nodes.summary: Crate root that declares all submodules and registers all proc-macro derive functions for the style_derive crate.
